frases.texto: You slip your dog a bite off your plate and figure it's fine.
frases.estilo: Dry and direct, with a half smile.

frases.texto: But some of our food really can hurt them.
The ASPCA, the animal welfare group, keeps a list of what not to feed your pets.
One: chocolate. The darker it is, the bigger the risk.
Two: grapes and raisins, which can cause kidney damage.
Three: onions, garlic, and chives, which can damage red blood cells and lead to anemia.
Heads up: the risk depends on how much they ate. If your dog got into any of these, call your vet.
Save this: chocolate, grapes, onions. Never off your plate.
